subject: Great meeting at AI Summit — Follow-up on inference needs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alexa Johnson <alexa@finovate.ai>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Great meeting at AI Summit — Follow-up on inference needs

Hi Alexa —

It was great to meet you at the AI Summit yesterday — thanks for taking a few minutes to walk me through Finovate's inference challenges. Quick recap from our side so we’re aligned:

- Primary pain: unpredictable latency impacting user-facing features (peak spikes during batch jobs)
- Unit cost is rising as model usage scales; looking for ways to reduce per-token spend without sacrificing quality
- Data residency / auditability is a hard requirement for a subset of your customers — you mentioned SOC 2 and strict retention controls

Next steps I proposed on the show floor: a 30-minute discovery call to map your current pipeline, traffic patterns, and potential quick wins (batching, quantization, routing). I’ve attached a short one-pager that summarizes Redwood’s deployment options (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) and typical outcomes for fintech customers.

Are you available next week for a 30-min call? Here are a few slots I have open: Wed 10/27 10–11am PT, Thu 10/28 2–4pm PT, or feel free to pick a time: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

If you prefer, I can loop in Mateo (cc’d) — he runs solutions for financial customers and can jump on the call to cover compliance and dedicated/private options.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- Redwood-OnePager.pdf (1 page)

Thanks —
Marissa

Thanks for following up, and apologies for the delay — things got busy after the conference. We’re definitely still interested in reducing inference latency and getting better visibility into cost drivers, but our roadmap has shifted and we’re now targeting a pilot in Q2 2027 rather than this quarter.
